item.title: CREMATE Bridge 30 Years of Chaos with New Lyric Video ‘Human’
item.description: In 1993, the world was a different place, but the darkest corners of the human psyche remain unchanged. Today, Greek death/thrash metal icon CREMATE taps into that timeless darkness with the premiere of the official lyric video for “Human,” a standout track from their powerhouse EP, Ready To Fight, out now via Wormholedeath. item.description: Finnish melodic death metal act Obscure Fate is about to release their debut album ‘Shades of a Dying World’ on March 27th 2026 via Inverse Records.
